text: 40岁男的：二十多年过去了，除了脸上的皱纹，我们都没变，你还是喜欢有钱的，而我还是喜欢18的。
en: 40-year-old man: More than twenty years have passed, and apart from the wrinkles on our faces, nothing about us has changed — you still like wealthy ones, and I still like 18-year-olds.

text: 我放着竹笋不吃，我啃竹子，莴笋新鲜的时候我不吃，我等他长老了，
en: I leave the bamboo shoots uneaten and chew on bamboo; when the celtuce is fresh I won't eat it — I wait until it has grown old,

text: 玫瑰开花的时候我不去拍照，不去合影，不去拍视频，
en: When the roses bloom I don't go to take photographs, don't take group photos, don't shoot videos,

text: 我等他，花瓣都枯萎了，再去拍照，
en: I wait until the petals have all withered before going to take photographs,

text: 豌豆尖刚长出来，我不吃，我不用它涮火锅，烫一下就吃，又嫩又爽滑，
en: When the pea tips have just sprouted I don't eat them; I don't use them for hotpot, blanching them briefly to eat — tender and smooth,

text: 我要等他长老了，长得全是筋膜，咬不动再吃，
en: I wait until they have grown old, grown all stringy and tough to chew before eating,

text: 经济情况允许的情况下，
en: Where the financial situation permits,

text: 新车我不买，我去买四手车，
en: I don't buy a new car; I go and buy a fourth-hand car,

text: 玉米嫩的时候我不煮，我要等它长硬了，
en: When the corn is tender I don't boil it; I wait until it has hardened,

text: 豆芽刚发出来，我不吃，我要等它变成植物，
en: When the bean sprouts have just sprouted I don't eat them; I wait until they turn into plants,

text: 答案一：一看你就是不靠谱的红娘，外行
en: Answer one: At a glance you're an unreliable matchmaker, an amateur.

text: 答案二：让你花五千块，买全新的苹果手机，你自己用了五年，也能接受。
en: Answer two: If you were asked to spend five thousand yuan on a brand-new Apple phone, and you yourself used it for five years, you could accept that too.

text: 但是让你花五千块，买一台，别人用了五年的，你还能接受？
en: But if you were asked to spend five thousand yuan on one that someone else had used for five years, could you still accept it?

text: 答案三，
en: Answer three,

text: 40岁老男人，愿意给18岁女生 花钱
en: 40-year-old old men are willing to spend money on 18-year-old girls.

text: 40岁老男人，愿意车接车送18岁女生
en: 40-year-old old men are willing to drive 18-year-old girls around.

text: 40岁老男人，愿意哄18岁女生
en: 40-year-old old men are willing to humour 18-year-old girls.

text: 而40岁老女人呢
en: And what about 40-year-old old women?

text: 面对18岁的男生
en: Facing 18-year-old boys,

text: 1做不到，给他花钱
en: 1. Can't do it — spend money on him.

text: 2做不到车接车送
en: 2. Can't do it — drive him around.

text: 3做不到哄他。
en: 3. Can't do it — humour him.

text: 相反，40岁老女人，还想18岁男人，给自己花钱，哄自己，给自己车接车送。
en: On the contrary, 40-year-old old women still want 18-year-old men to spend money on them, humour them, and drive them around.

text: 面对18岁，年轻力壮，真少年的小男生，40岁老女人都做不到。
en: Facing 18-year-old, vigorous, genuinely youthful young boys, 40-year-old old women can't manage it either.

text: 更别说40岁的老男人了。
en: Let alone 40-year-old old men.

text: 既然40岁的老女人，对40岁的老男人，做不到这些。
en: Since 40-year-old old women can't do these things for 40-year-old old men,

text: 40岁的老男人，为啥要要40岁的老女人？
en: Why would a 40-year-old old man want a 40-year-old old woman?

text: 找18岁的不香吗？
en: Isn't an 18-year-old better?

text: 答案四，至于你说的，条件不好的40岁老男人，也不愿意找40岁的老女人。
en: Answer four. As for what you said, 40-year-old old men in poor circumstances are also unwilling to go for 40-year-old old women.

text: 第一，40岁的老女人，愿意找条件不好的同龄人吗？
en: First, would a 40-year-old old woman be willing to go for a same-age peer in poor circumstances?

text: 第二，40岁的老女人，会补贴同龄人吗？
en: Second, would a 40-year-old old woman subsidise a same-age peer?

text: 说实话，有点无语。
en: To be honest, it's a bit much.

text: 时代变化的太快了，还是缺女人。
en: The times are changing too fast, and there is still a shortage of women.

text: 有相当一部分年龄大的男性缺女人，但嘴硬。
en: A fair number of older men are short of women, but they talk tough.

text: 本着买菜的心里挑挑拣拣。
en: Picking and choosing with the mentality of shopping for vegetables.

text: 十年前怎么可能有人讨论40岁的女人结不结婚？
en: How could anyone have discussed ten years ago whether a 40-year-old woman would marry or not?

text: 搞笑呢？
en: Are you having a laugh?

text: 女的都40了，结不结婚是咋地？
en: The woman's already 40 — what's it to anyone whether she marries or not?

text: 根本没人讨论，随便!
en: No one discussed it at all — whatever!

text: 我认为能有这个标题，就证明想、缺。
en: I think that the mere existence of this title proves there is longing, and shortage.

text: 没必要讨论了，人家单身到40了，根本就打算不嫁人。
en: There's no need to discuss it — she's stayed single to 40, she simply never intended to marry.

text: 任何以嘲讽、谩骂、诅咒、彩礼，挑40岁女人的不是的，我都认为他缺女人。
en: Anyone who uses ridicule, abuse, curses, or bride price to pick faults with 40-year-old women, I regard as someone short of women.

text: 而不是女人缺他。
en: Rather than women being short of him.

text: 无语
en: Speechless.

text: 40岁的男女实互相都看不上，都阅历太多太精明，说实话40岁男人条件好吗？
en: 40-year-old men and women actually look down on each other, both having too much experience and being too shrewd. Honestly, are 40-year-old men's circumstances good?

text: 无非是有几套房子罢了，婚前和别人又没有什么关系，很多企业40岁以上中高层都要下岗，连华为这种都是，除非是自己做企业做得不错，大部分这个年龄段收入都走下坡路随时可能大降，再加上性能力大降，但凡有脑子的二十多女孩子不会找四十多地。
en: Nothing more than a few properties, really — and pre-marital assets have nothing to do with others. Many firms make middle and senior managers over 40 redundant, even ones like Huawei. Unless they run their own business well, most people this age see their income going downhill and liable to drop sharply at any time; add to that a major decline in sexual ability, and any sensible twenty-something girl wouldn't go for a forty-something.

text: 别人找个二十几岁同龄人尽管现在穷将来无限可能，收入会长时间处于一个上升通道，人家挣钱时间也比四十多多二十年好吧！
en: Others find a twenty-something peer; though poor now, the future holds infinite possibility, and income will stay on an upward trajectory for a long time; they'll also have twenty more years of earning than a forty-something, surely!

text: 当然你说那些没什么生存能力也无脑的年轻女人想找真是太多了马路上一堆，年轻男人也多啊！
en: Of course, as for those young women with no real survival skills and no brains who want to find one — there are far too many of them, a crowd out on the streets, and there are plenty of young men too!

text: 有什么意义？
en: What's the point?

text: 不怕分走财产就行，男人女人都岔着找，你要愿意每天可以不重样。
en: Just as long as you're not afraid of assets being split off — men and women both pair up across age gaps; if you're willing, you could have someone different every day.

text: 我已经见过别人找了五十多主任找得二十多同事，开始快乐两年，后来咔咔咔一下岗，那女孩跑了，钱也弄跑了现在五十多光溜老头一个，没事干天天买个房车一个人自己到处晃，前妻嫁人。
en: I've already seen someone who, as a fiftysomething director, found a twentysomething colleague; it was happy for two years to begin with, then click-clack he was made redundant, the girl ran off, and the money went with her. Now he's just a fiftysomething old man with nothing to his name, with nothing to do, buying a motorhome and wandering about on his own every day, while his ex-wife has remarried.

text: 不考虑
en: Not worth considering.

text: 40岁女性基本上也不会考虑同龄男性，好伐？
en: 40-year-old women basically won't consider men their own age either, okay?

text: 找大十几岁的能提供经济支持，宠你包容你。
en: Finding someone ten-odd years older can provide financial support, dote on you and tolerate you.

text: 小十几岁的图个年轻有颜，给他花钱花的开心。
en: Someone ten-odd years younger — you're after the youth and looks, and enjoy spending money on them.

text: 俩四十岁的人，最好的缘分是，做哥们儿。
en: Two forty-year-olds' best fate is to be mates.

text: 在今年的时候，小区有一个男生结婚了。
en: Earlier this year, a young man in the residential estate got married.

text: 他出生于1993年，在32岁的年纪结婚，这绝对是一件值得庆祝的事情。
en: He was born in 1993 and married at the age of 32 — this is absolutely something worth celebrating.

text: 男生32岁还没有结婚，放在大城市的话，还算年轻。
en: A young man of 32 who is still unmarried, in a big city, would still be considered young.

text: 但是呢，在小城市小地方，男生到了32岁还没有结婚，就已经很要紧了。
en: But then, in small cities and towns, a young man who reaches 32 without marrying is already quite a serious matter.

text: 他结婚的时候，有一位朋友参加了婚礼。
en: When he married, a friend attended the wedding.

text: 通过这个朋友得知，他的老婆今年才19岁。
en: Through this friend I learned that his wife is only 19 this year.

text: 朋友第一次说的时候，我以为听错了，再次询问了一下多少岁。
en: When the friend first said it, I thought I'd misheard, and asked again how old she was.

text: 朋友用大一点的声音表示，他的老婆才19岁。
en: The friend said in a louder voice that his wife was only 19.

text: 一个32岁的男生，娶了一个刚刚成年的女生，两个人相差了十几岁，这多少让人觉得有点不可思议以及震惊。
en: A 32-year-old young man married a girl who had just come of age; the two are over ten years apart, which is somewhat unbelievable and shocking.

text: 男生的条件并不算很好，也并不算很差。
en: The young man's circumstances are neither especially good nor especially bad.

text: 一米七左右的身高，一辆十几万的代步车，加上一套有房贷的房子。
en: About 1.7 metres tall, a runabout car worth over a hundred thousand yuan, plus a flat with a mortgage.

text: 收入扣除所有开支之后，每个月能存两三千这样。
en: After deducting all expenses from his income, he can save two or three thousand a month, roughly.

text: 这么一个条件，男生想找一个三十左右的女生，简直是一件痴人说梦。
en: With such circumstances, for the young man to want to find a girl around thirty is simply a pipe dream.

text: 在绝大多数三十多岁的女生心中，男生这个条件根本就入如了眼。
en: In the eyes of most thirty-something women, this young man's circumstances simply don't measure up.

text: 先不说房贷，就说男生每个月存两三千，女生和男生在一起，这么点存款怎么维持女生的精致生活？
en: Not to mention the mortgage — just consider that the young man saves two or three thousand a month; how could a girl maintain her refined lifestyle with so little in savings if she's with him?

text: 不知道大家有没有发现，超过三十岁的女生，要求并不是越来越低，反而是变得越来越高。
en: I wonder if everyone's noticed that women over thirty don't lower their requirements — on the contrary, they grow higher and higher.

text: 反而是小姑娘，她们不会计较那么多。
en: It's the young girls who don't fuss over so much.

text: 男生有房有车有存款就已经很好了，根本就不会考虑那么多。
en: As long as the young man has a flat, a car and savings, that's already plenty good — they simply don't think that much about it.

text: 也正是因为这样，同等年纪的情况下，三四十岁的男生，根本就看不上三四十岁的女生。
en: It's precisely because of this that, at the same age, thirty- and forty-something men simply look down on thirty- and forty-something women.

text: 那么女生到了四十岁还单身的话，是不是就应该认命了？
en: Then if a woman reaches forty and is still single, should she just accept her fate?

text: 女生到了四十岁，如果还想找到男人的话，那么就得要适当降低自己的择偶要求。
en: When a woman reaches forty, if she still wants to find a man, then she must appropriately lower her partner-selection requirements.

text: 你不能已经四十岁的年纪，择偶要求还是二十岁小姑娘的身份。
en: You can't be forty years old yet still hold the partner standards of a twenty-year-old girl.

text: 只要是稍微正常的男生，能达到你条件的，肯定会选择小姑娘，而不是会选择你。
en: Any even moderately normal young man who meets your criteria would certainly choose a young girl, not you.

text: 女生到了四十岁，如果不想将就凑合，那么也很简单，女生可以攒钱。
en: When a woman reaches forty, if she doesn't want to settle, it's also simple — she can save money.

text: 只要钱攒够了，那么再过个十几年，就能过上退休的生活。
en: Once enough money is saved, then after another ten-odd years she can live a retired life.

text: 自己一个人，也有一个人的活法。
en: Living alone, there is also a way to live for one.

text: 女生选择了这条路，那么就要彻底放得开，不要想那么多。
en: If a woman chooses this path, then she must let go completely and not overthink.

text: 有些女生不知道是怎么想的，又想脱单，又不想降低要求，这又当又立的行为，会让男生感觉很不舒服。
en: Some women — who knows what they're thinking — want to get out of singlehood yet won't lower their standards; this hypocritical, want-it-both-ways behaviour makes young men feel very uncomfortable.

text: 不知道大家有没有发现一个问题，正常来说，二十出头的男生，找个二十出头的女生是最合适的，两个人年纪相当，实力相当。
en: I wonder if everyone's noticed a problem: normally, a man in his early twenties finding a woman in her early twenties is most suitable — the two are of similar age and similar means.

text: 但是现实生活中，二十出头的男生没有家里面人撑腰的话，正在忙于生计，为了活着奔波。
en: But in real life, a man in his early twenties without family backing is busy making a living, rushing around just to survive.

text: 二十出头的女生，不想过这样的日子，就会放弃同等年纪的男生。
en: A woman in her early twenties, not wanting such a life, will give up on men her own age.

text: 女生只要进入了三十岁之后，还没有把自己嫁出去的话。
en: Once a woman passes thirty and still hasn't married herself off,

text: 这个时候的同龄男生收入上去了，绝对不会选择同龄女生，而是追求更加年轻漂亮的小姑娘。
en: by then her same-age male peers' incomes have risen, and they absolutely won't choose same-age women, but pursue younger, prettier girls.

text: 这个世界上没有那么多高富帅，女生要认清楚这点！
en: There aren't that many tall, rich and handsome men in this world — women must recognise this clearly!
